facts.business: India Cements Capital Limited operates in financial services through its subsidiary India Cements Investment Services Limited, which provides stock broking services in cash market and futures & options segments.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Taxability of write-back of borrowings (Rs. 43.55 crores) and write-off of advances (Rs. 43.60 crores) under Income Tax Act, 1961; no tax provision made based on tax professional opinion

key_risks: Taxability uncertainty on write-back of borrowings and write-off of advances
Declining turnover in subsidiary (from Rs. 71,551 lakhs to Rs. 42,441 lakhs)
